manifest.name: dsh-task-groups
manifest.description: Task groups and an activity bell for the DSH sidebar: organize sessions by your own groups and follow running/unread conversations.

bundle.text:
# dsh-task-groups bundle patch: one plugin row, no config.
- insert:
    - id: task-groups
      name: 'dsh-task-groups'

readme.text: <div align="center">

**给任务分个组，把正在发生的事放到眼前。** 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加自定义任务分组和活动铃铛。 [](package.json) [](package.json) [](LICENSE) **中文** · [English](README.en.md) [功能预览](#preview) · [快速安装](#install) · [使用指南](#usage) · [反馈问题](https://github.com/spike237/dsh-task-groups/issues)

readme.section: ✨ 两个小功能，让侧边栏更好用
readme.text:
🗂️ 任务分组 🔔 活动铃铛

按主题归类，自由拖拽排序。

集中查看运行中、待确认和未读会话。

readme.section: 🗂️ 按自己的方式整理任务
readme.text:
- **自定义分组**：把相关会话放在一起，为分组命名、换色，随时折叠或展开。 - **拖拽整理**：调整任务和分组的顺序；拖进分组即可归类，拖到组外即可移出。分组也可以放在未分组任务之间。 - **组内操作**：直接新建任务，或批量标为已读、归档会话。 - **保留项目视图**：随时切回按工作区查看，继续使用「显示更多」展开任务列表。
📁 查看项目视图

readme.section: 🔔 一眼找到需要关注的会话
readme.text: 点击侧边栏的小铃铛，打开「活动」面板。**运行中、等待确认和未读的会话**会集中在「优先级」，其余会话列在「其他」。 打开未读会话后，它仍会留在「优先级」，方便来回查看。处理完后，点击右上角的**扫帚（清除已读）**，将可清理的会话移入「其他」；运行中或等待确认的会话会继续保留。再次点击铃铛即可返回任务列表。

需要已安装并运行过的 **DeepSeek Harness**，以及 **Git** 和 **Node.js 20.11+**。以下以 Windows 的默认 `desktop` profile 为例：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/spike237/dsh-task-groups.git
cd dsh-task-groups
node tools/enable-profile.mjs
```

也可以直接从 npm 安装（需要 DSH 0.2.1+）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-task-groups
```

**重启 DSH**，侧边栏出现「分组 / 项目」切换和小铃铛后即可使用。

> [!NOTE]
> 安装脚本会备份并修改已有的 profile 配置，将插件链接到当前仓库目录。安装后请保留这个目录；如果移动了目录，需要重新设置链接。

<details>
<summary>其他 profile、自定义路径与卸载</summary>

指定已有的 profile： ```powershell node tools/enable-profile.mjs --profile my-profile ``` 指定 DSH 数据目录（其中需已有对应的 `profiles//package.json`）： ```powershell node tools/enable-profile.mjs --home "D:\DSH" --profile desktop ``` 未传入 `--home` 时，脚本优先使用环境变量 `DSH_HOME`，否则使用 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`。 卸载默认 profile 中的插件，然后重启 DSH： ```powershell node tools/enable-profile.mjs --remove ``` 如果安装时指定了 `--home` 或 `--profile`，卸载时使用相同参数。卸载会移除插件配置与目录链接，保留分组数据。

右键分组即可打开操作菜单，选择 **新建分组** 后，再把相关任务拖进去。

| 想做什么 | 怎么操作 |
| --- | --- |
| 新建分组 | 右键分组 → 新建分组，也可使用顶部 `⋯` 菜单 |
| 切换整理方式 | 点击顶部「分组 / 项目」 |
| 修改分组名称或颜色 | 点击分组前的彩色 `#` 图标 |
| 在组内新建任务 | 点击分组右侧的 `⊕` |
| 调整顺序或所属分组 | 拖动任务或分组，按插入线放置 |
| 查看当前活动 | 点击小铃铛；再次点击返回 |
| 清理活动列表 | 点击活动面板右上角的扫帚 |
| 搜索任务 | 顶部 `⋯` → 搜索任务 |
| 更多任务操作 | 右键任务，可重命名、置顶、标记未读、分支、移动到分组或归档 |

删除分组只会解除任务的分组关系，任务仍然保留。右键分组还可以编辑、全部标为已读或批量归档会话。

分组、任务归属、排序和视图偏好保存在 `$DSH_HOME/task-groups/state.json`；未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时使用用户目录下的 `.dsh`。由 Host 校验并原子写入，重启后可恢复。

<details>
<summary>运行检查</summary>

Host 状态读写与校验：

```powershell
npm run smoke
```

界面渲染与交互检查需要一个已安装 `react`、`react-dom` 和 `jsdom` 的开发环境。将 `DSH_DEV_CHECKOUT` 指向该环境的 `package.json`：

```powershell
$env:DSH_DEV_CHECKOUT = "D:\path\to\dev-project\package.json"
npm test
```

覆盖分组、拖拽、项目视图、活动面板与菜单交互。

</details>

readme.section: ✨ Two small additions to your sidebar
readme.text: Group conversations the way you work, then check the bell when several tasks are active at once.

readme.section: ✨ Two small additions to your sidebar
readme.text:
🗂️ Task groups 🔔 Activity bell

Group by topic. Drag to arrange.

Find running, waiting and unread conversations.

- **Custom groups:** name, color, collapse and expand groups of related conversations.
- **Drag to organize:** reorder tasks and groups, move tasks into or out of a group, and place groups between ungrouped tasks.
- **Group actions:** start a task inside a group, mark its conversations as read, or archive them in bulk.
- **Project view:** switch back to workspace-based browsing, with “Show more” to expand the task list.

<details>
<summary>📁 See the project view</summary>

Click the bell to open the activity panel. **Running conversations, pending confirmations and unread conversations** appear under “Priority” (优先级); the rest appear under “Others” (其他). Opening an unread conversation keeps it in the priority list so you can return to it. When you are done, click the **broom** to move eligible conversations to “Others”; running conversations and pending confirmations stay in place. Click the bell again to return to your task list.

You need an existing **DeepSeek Harness** installation that has been launched at least once, **Git**, and **Node.js 20.11+**. For the default `desktop` profile on Windows:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/spike237/dsh-task-groups.git
cd dsh-task-groups
node tools/enable-profile.mjs
```

Or install from npm (requires DSH 0.2.1+):

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-task-groups
```

**Restart DSH.** The sidebar will show the “Groups / Projects” toggle and the bell.

> [!NOTE]
> The installer backs up and updates an existing profile configuration, then links the plugin to this checkout. Keep the repository directory in place; moving it requires updating the link.

<details>
<summary>Other profiles, custom paths and uninstalling</summary>

Choose an existing profile:

```powershell
node tools/enable-profile.mjs --profile my-profile
```

Choose a DSH data directory that already contains the corresponding `profiles/<name>/package.json`:

```powershell
node tools/enable-profile.mjs --home "D:\DSH" --profile desktop
```

Without `--home`, the installer uses `DSH_HOME` if set, otherwise `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`.

To uninstall from the default profile, run this command and restart DSH:

```powershell
node tools/enable-profile.mjs --remove
```

If you installed with `--home` or `--profile`, use the same arguments when uninstalling. Uninstalling removes the plugin configuration and directory link, while keeping saved group data.
Right-click a group to open its menu, choose **New group (新建分组)**, then drag related tasks into it.

| Action | How |
| --- | --- |
| Create a group | Right-click a group → New group, or use the top `⋯` menu |
| Switch views | Click “Groups / Projects” (分组 / 项目) |
| Rename or recolor a group | Click its colored `#` icon |
| Start a task in a group | Click the group’s `⊕` button |
| Reorder or move tasks | Drag a task or group and follow the insertion line |
| Check activity | Click the bell; click again to go back |
| Clear the activity list | Click the broom in the activity panel |
| Search tasks | Top `⋯` → Search tasks (搜索任务) |
| More task actions | Right-click to rename, pin, mark unread, branch, move to a group or archive |
Deleting a group removes its assignments and keeps its tasks. Right-click a group to edit it, mark all its conversations as read, or archive them in bulk.

Groups, task assignments, ordering and view preferences are saved to `$DSH_HOME/task-groups/state.json`, or `.dsh` under your home directory when `DSH_HOME` is unset. The Host validates and writes state atomically so it survives restarts.

<details>
<summary>Run checks</summary>

Host state persistence and validation:

```powershell
npm run smoke
```

UI checks need a development environment with `react`, `react-dom` and `jsdom` installed. Point `DSH_DEV_CHECKOUT` to that environment’s `package.json`:

```powershell
$env:DSH_DEV_CHECKOUT = "D:\path\to\dev-project\package.json"
npm test
```

Covers groups, drag and drop, project view, activity and menus.

</details>
